note: The site-hooks gate's exceptions (tools/src/gates/check-site-hooks.ts reads it; nothing generates from it): a data-kb-* hook the site's markup emits and no program reads, kept for a person or an agent reading the built page. An entry is { name, match, reason }: match is the hook's exact name, reason says who reads it. The gate fails an entry that excuses nothing, so an exception cannot outlive its cause. Edit this file, then run: make gate G=check-site-hooks && make gate G=check-json.

entries.name: shield-reason
entries.reason: States, in words, why a shielded subtree is skipped. Its value is prose for whoever reads the built page, a person or an agent, and no code branches on it.
